player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} ({piece}). Opponent is ({opp}). Submit moves as '[b1 c3]' (from → to). All pieces move like chess knights.
Each capture scores {score_per_capture} point. Game ends after {max_moves} moves or when a player has no legal move / no pieces. Higher score wins.

invalid_move.not_knight: No l'é unna mossa de cavalier.

game_action.moved: Giöcatô {player_id} a spostou o seu pezzo da {frm} a {to}.

outcome.no_pieces: O zugatô {player_id} o no gh'à de peççe.
outcome.cannot_move: O zugatô {player_id} o no peu fâ ninte.
outcome.higher_score: A ciù gròssa puntuaçion de cattura.
outcome.move_limit: O limite de moviménto o l'é arivòu.
